ServiceNow Developer (cid:131) +91 7004885397 # tech.abhishek.barnwal@gmail.com * Bengaluru, India (cid:239) linkedin.com/in/abhishek-barnwal

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

ServiceNow Developer with 4 years of experience at Virtusa Pvt Ltd, specializing in ITSM module development, workflow automation, and platform customization. Skilled in gathering client requirements, translating business needs into scalable technical solutions, and delivering high-quality results. Proven ability to enhance operational efficiency through automation and cross-functional collaboration. PROJECT EXPERIENCE

Virtusa Pvt. Ltd. Software Engineer

May 2022 – Present Bengaluru, India

Siemens Healthineers Technology Used: ServiceNow and SAP Integration – Integrated SAP systems with ServiceNow using OAuth 2.0 authentication and REST APIs to securely retrieve and provide seamless

data flow between SAP and ServiceNow platforms.

Developed interactive ServiceNow dashboards and reports with dynamic content blocks and filters, enabling real-time data analysis and decision-making.

Designed and enforced data validation rules and transformation logic to implement bulk data import solutions using Import Sets and Transform Maps to process Excel data into ServiceNow tables.

Managed roles and access controls, developed and deployed user surveys.Contributed to seamless ServiceNow operations, enhancing platform performance, user experience, and workflow automation. Created Scheduled Job for emails and reports.

Led end-to-end client engagement, from requirement gathering to designing and delivering effective technical solutions.

Comcast (Mass Media Corporation) Technology Used: ServiceNow Platform • Delivered end-to-end development and support across core ServiceNow ITSM modules including Incident, Problem, Change, Knowl-

edge Management, Service Catalog, Request Fulfillment, and Self-Service Portal also worked on creating users, roles, groups.

Proficient in ServiceNow development with strong hands-on experience in App Engine Studio, including designing and building scoped/ custom applications tailored to business needs.

Customized and maintained Client Scripts, Business Rules, Script Includes, UI Actions, UI Policies, Notifications, ACLs, and SLAs to align with business processes. Configured Record Producers for Incident to be raised via portal.

Designed and implemented Flows and Sub-Flows using Flow Designer, automated tasks using Background Scripts, managed data imports via Import Sets and Transform Maps, ensuring accurate and efficient data transformation into ServiceNow tables.

TECHNICAL SKILLS

Languages: JavaScript (JS), Java 11, SQL, HTML, CSS

ServiceNow: ITSM, ACLs, SLAs, Flow or Workflow Designer, Service Portal, App Engine Studio, UI Builder, Scripting, Integration

Frameworks: Spring Boot, Spring Framework, Hibernate-JPA, RESTful

Tools: Git, Maven, Postman, SQL Workbench, ServiceNow

CERTIFICATIONS & TRAININGS

ServiceNow CSA – View Certificate

Oracle Certified Java Associate (OCJA) – View Certificate

Runner-up – Virtusa ServiceNow Hackathon won cash prize

NPTEL – Programming and Data Structures – View Certificate

EDUCATION

Techno Main Salt Lake College B.Tech in Computer Science | 8.9 CGPA

2018 – 2022 Kolkata, West Bengal

HOBBIES

Cricket, Coding, Watching Movies
